name: Hanani
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return

points: These are the words of Nehemiah the son of Hachaliah. In the month Chisleu, in the twentieth year, as he was in the palace, Hanani one of his brethren comes with certain men of Judah, and Nehemiah asks concerning the Jews that had escaped the captivity and concerning Jerusalem.
